merchandise.name: Official BITSians' Day Tshirt
merchandise.description:
Orders in India are brought to you by **_Indipeepal_** All BITSAA proceeds after paying the vendor will be donated to BITS

Orders in the USA, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, and Japan are brought to you by **_Sigo Entreprise._**

Special Mentions:

Kudos to Sigo Entreprise (**_Surendra Malu, 2001 Batch_**) for their generous contribution by donating the entire profit from BITS merchandise sales.

Congratulations to our T-shirt design contest winners: **Aditya Malhotra** and **Bartik Pandel.** Their creativity has truly captured the spirit and legacy of BITS Pilani.

A heartfelt thank you to **_Siraj Naik_** (BITS Pilani marketing team) for creating the amazing 60 years poster that inspired Bartik's winning design.

Let's come together to make this BITSians' Day an unforgettable celebration of our shared heritage and bright future. Wear your T-shirt with pride and be a part of this historic moment!

merchandise.name: Reconnect with a BITS Postcard
merchandise.description:
In the age of emails and video calls, let's send postcards to our wingies, club-mates, juniors, seniors, book moms/dads, professors, guards, redi bhaiyas, and everyone who made your BITS journey special! Presenting the BITS Pilani Postcard series by Harshikha Gupta (Pilani '13). Revive memories and share handwritten messages that will be cherished for years to come. 
🕒Within India, delivery time is ~3-5 days. India link : https://www.harshispostcards.com/ 
📧For international orders pls drop an email at harshispostcards@gmail.com

donate.name:
BIT by BIT for BITS - 
60 years of BITS Pilani
donate.description:
**We are pleased to announce the launch of this year's BITSians' Day campaign - _Bit by Bit for BITS_ - aimed at garnering sustained support for the student community through our Monthly Giving Campaign**.

In 2022, we proudly awarded **$26K worth of scholarships** to support more than **100 students**- a remarkable achievement made possible by your philanthropic spirit. Alumni contributions have always been instrumental in nurturing and uplifting the next generation of BITSians.

**We invite you to join us in making this recurring donor drive a resounding success**. Even a modest pledge from us alumni can create an incredible impact for the students. 

_If a batch of 500 pledges to donate a dollar a day, they can potentially support Merit-cum-Needs scholarships for 40 students a year!_
